exercises.name: March on the spot
cues: Stand tall and lift one knee, then the other, at an easy rhythm.
Let your arms swing loosely by your sides.

easier.name: Slow march with support
easier.how: Hold a chair back or bench and march slowly with low knees.

standard.name: March on the spot
standard.how: Lift your knees to a comfortable height and swing your arms.

harder.name: High-knee march
harder.how: Lift each knee toward hip height and swing your arms with it.

exercises.name: Easy walk
cues: Walk at a pace where you could talk in full sentences.
Relax your shoulders and let your arms swing.

easier.name: Slow walk
easier.how: Walk slowly with short, relaxed steps.

standard.name: Easy walk
standard.how: Walk at a relaxed pace on firm, level ground or firm sand.

harder.name: Easy walk with arm swings
harder.how: Walk at a relaxed pace and swing your arms a little wider.

exercises.name: Ankle circles
cues: Draw slow, full circles with your toes.
Circle both ways, about half the time each.

easier.name: Seated ankle circles
easier.how: Sit on a chair, lift one foot a little and circle the ankle.

standard.name: Standing ankle circles
standard.how: Hold a support, lift one foot a little and circle the ankle.

harder.name: Ankle circles, light support
harder.how: Stand on one leg with fingertips on a wall and circle the other ankle.

exercises.name: Upper-back rotation
cues: Turn from the middle of your back and let your head turn with you.
Breathe out as you turn, and keep the movement slow.

easier.name: Seated rotation
easier.how: Sit tall with arms crossed over your chest and turn gently to one side.

standard.name: Side-lying open book
standard.how: Lie on your side, knees bent and arms out in front, and open the top arm across to the other side.

harder.name: Open book with a hold
harder.how: Do the open book and hold the open position for 3 seconds each time.

exercises.name: Calf stretch
cues: Keep the back heel on the ground.
Lean until you feel a gentle stretch, then hold still.

easier.name: Bent-knee calf stretch
easier.how: Hands on a wall, one foot a short step back, and bend the back knee a little.

standard.name: Wall calf stretch
standard.how: Hands on a wall, one foot back with the leg straight, and lean forward.

harder.name: Long-stance calf stretch
harder.how: As the wall calf stretch, with the back foot further from the wall.

exercises.name: Hip flexor stretch
cues: Tuck your tailbone under a little before you lean.
Stay upright; the stretch is at the front of the back hip.

easier.name: Standing hip flexor stretch
easier.how: Hold a chair in a split stance, bend the front knee and tuck your tailbone.

standard.name: Half-kneeling hip flexor stretch
standard.how: Kneel on one knee on a cushion, other foot in front, and shift your hips forward.

harder.name: Half-kneeling stretch with reach
harder.how: In the half-kneeling stretch, reach the arm on the kneeling side up overhead.

exercises.name: Squat
cues: Feet about shoulder-width apart, toes turned out a little.
Sit your hips back and keep your knees in line with your toes.
Press the floor away to stand up tall.

easier.name: Sit-to-stand
easier.how: Sit fully on a sturdy chair, then stand up; press on your thighs with your hands if you need to.

standard.name: Squat to a chair
standard.how: Lower until you lightly touch the chair seat, then stand without sitting down.

harder.name: Bodyweight squat
harder.how: Squat without the chair, taking 3 seconds to lower.

exercises.name: Split squat
cues: Take a long enough step that both knees can bend to about a right angle.
Lower straight down with your front heel on the floor.
Do all the reps on one side, then switch.

easier.name: Supported split squat
easier.how: Hold a wall or chair back and lower only part of the way.

standard.name: Split squat
standard.how: Stand in a split stance and lower your back knee toward the floor, then rise.

harder.name: Reverse lunge
harder.how: Step one foot back into the split squat, then step it forward again to stand.

exercises.name: Glute bridge
cues: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat and hip-width apart.
Squeeze your buttocks to lift your hips, then lower slowly.
Keep your ribs down so the lift comes from your hips.

easier.name: Short bridge
easier.how: Lift your hips only part of the way, then lower.

standard.name: Glute bridge
standard.how: Lift your hips until your shoulders, hips and knees are in a line.

harder.name: Single-leg bridge
harder.how: Lift with one foot on the floor and the other leg straight out; do both sides.

exercises.name: Calf raise
cues: Rise onto the balls of your feet, then lower slowly.
Keep your ankles straight, not rolling out.
If standing, hold a wall or rail lightly for balance.

easier.name: Seated calf raise
easier.how: Sit on a chair and lift your heels as high as you can.

standard.name: Calf raise
standard.how: Stand on level ground, lightly holding a wall, and rise on both feet.

harder.name: Single-leg calf raise
harder.how: Rise on one foot while holding a wall; do both sides.

exercises.name: Step-up
cues: Put your whole foot on the step.
Press through the heel of the top foot to stand up.
Step down slowly; do all the reps on one side, then switch.

easier.name: Low step-up
easier.how: Use the bottom stair or a low step and hold the rail.

standard.name: Step-up
standard.how: Step onto a stair or sturdy step about shin height, holding a rail if there is one.

harder.name: Step-up with slow lowering
harder.how: Step up, then take 3 seconds to step back down.

exercises.name: Hip hinge to a box
cues: Soften your knees, then push your hips back as if closing a drawer behind you.
Keep your back long from head to hips.
Squeeze your buttocks to stand tall.

easier.name: Hands-on-thighs hinge
easier.how: Slide your hands down your thighs to just above your knees, then stand tall.

standard.name: Hip hinge to a box
standard.how: Stand in front of a box or chair seat and hinge toward it, only as far as your back stays long, then stand tall.

harder.name: Slow hip hinge
harder.how: Hinge toward the box, only as far as your back stays long, taking 3 seconds on the way down.

exercises.name: Push-up
cues: Hands a little wider than your shoulders.
Keep your body in one straight line.
Lower under control, then press the surface away.

easier.name: Wall push-up
easier.how: Hands on a wall at shoulder height, feet a step back.

standard.name: Incline push-up
standard.how: Hands on a sturdy bench, bench top or rail about hip height.

harder.name: Kneeling push-up
harder.how: Hands on the floor and knees down, with your body straight from head to knees.

exercises.name: Pike push-up
cues: Lift your hips high so your body makes an upside-down V.
Bend your elbows to bring your head toward your hands, then press back up.
Keep your neck relaxed and look back toward your feet.

easier.name: Benchtop pike push-up
easier.how: Hands on a kitchen benchtop or table edge at about hip height, feet back and hips high.

standard.name: Incline pike push-up
standard.how: Hands on a sturdy bench, or a chair seat with its back to a wall, feet on the floor and hips high.

harder.name: Slow incline pike push-up
harder.how: As the incline pike push-up, taking 3 seconds to lower.

dumbbell.name: Dumbbell shoulder press
dumbbell.how: Sit tall and press two dumbbells from shoulder height to overhead.
cues: Sit tall with your feet flat and your back against the chair.
Keep your ribs down so your lower back stays still.
Press up, not forward, then lower to shoulder height slowly.

exercises.name: Row
cues: Pull your elbows back and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Keep your neck long and your shoulders away from your ears.
Return to straight arms slowly.

easier.name: High-rail row
easier.how: Use a strong rail fixed to a wall or post at chest height (not a table, chair or broom), so you are nearly upright.

standard.name: Inverted row on a rail
standard.how: Hold a rail fixed to a wall or post at waist height that holds your full weight (not a table, chair or broom), lean back and pull in.

harder.name: Low-rail row
harder.how: Use a strong rail fixed to a wall or post at hip height or lower (not a table, chair or broom), feet further forward.

band.name: Band row
band.how: Loop a band around a strong, fixed post at chest height and pull the ends toward you.

dumbbell.name: One-arm dumbbell row
dumbbell.how: One hand and knee on a bench, pull the dumbbell toward your hip; do both sides.

exercises.name: Band pull-apart
cues: Hold the band in front at shoulder height with straight arms.
Pull the band apart toward your chest, then return slowly.
Keep your shoulders down.

easier.name: Wide-grip pull-apart
easier.how: Hold the band with your hands further apart, so it pulls less.

standard.name: Band pull-apart
standard.how: Hold the band with your hands shoulder-width apart.

harder.name: Pull-apart with a pause
harder.how: Hold the band apart for 2 seconds before you return.

exercises.name: Dead bug
cues: Lie on your back, knees bent over your hips and arms pointing up.
Press your lower back gently into the floor and keep it there.
Breathe out as you reach.

easier.name: Heel taps
easier.how: Keep your arms still and lower one heel to tap the floor, then the other.

standard.name: Dead bug
standard.how: Lower the opposite arm and leg toward the floor, then return; alternate sides.

harder.name: Slow dead bug
harder.how: As the dead bug, taking 3 seconds to reach out.

exercises.name: Bird-dog
cues: Hands under your shoulders, knees under your hips.
Reach long without letting your back sag or twist.
Move slowly enough to keep your hips level.

easier.name: One-limb bird-dog
easier.how: Reach out one arm or one leg at a time.

standard.name: Bird-dog
standard.how: Reach the opposite arm and leg out straight, then return; alternate sides.

harder.name: Bird-dog with a hold
harder.how: Hold each reach for 3 seconds.

exercises.name: Front plank
cues: Elbows under or just in front of your shoulders.
Keep one straight line from your head to your heels or knees.
Breathe steadily the whole time.

easier.name: Kneeling plank
easier.how: Forearms and knees on the floor.

standard.name: Front plank
standard.how: Forearms and toes on the floor.

harder.name: Long plank
harder.how: As the front plank, with your elbows a little in front of your shoulders.

exercises.name: Side plank
cues: Elbow under your shoulder.
Lift your hips so your body is in one line.
Hold each side for the same time.

easier.name: Kneeling side plank
easier.how: Forearm and knees on the floor, knees bent behind you.

standard.name: Side plank
standard.how: Forearm and the sides of your feet on the floor, one foot in front of the other.

harder.name: Stacked side plank
harder.how: As the side plank, with one foot on top of the other.

exercises.name: Beach walk
cues: Walk tall with relaxed shoulders.
Brisk means you can still talk, but would rather not sing.

easier.name: Easy walk on firm sand
easier.how: Walk at a relaxed pace on firm sand.
cues: Walk at an easy pace where you could talk in full sentences.
Walk tall with relaxed shoulders.

standard.name: Brisk walk on firm sand
standard.how: Walk briskly on firm, wet sand near the waterline.

harder.name: Walk with soft-sand stretches
harder.how: Walk on firm sand and spend 2 to 3 minutes on softer sand near the middle of the walk.

exercises.name: Beach jog intervals
cues: Jog slowly enough to talk, with short, light steps.
Walk between jogs for the full break.

easier.name: Brisk walk intervals
easier.how: Walk briskly instead of jogging, with easy walking in between.
cues: Walk briskly, but slowly enough to talk, with short, light steps.
Walk easily between brisk walks for the full break.

standard.name: Easy jog on firm sand
standard.how: Jog gently on firm, wet sand, then walk until the next jog.

harder.name: Steady jog on firm sand
harder.how: Jog a little quicker while you can still talk.

templates.summary: Full body: squat, push-up, bridge, row and core.

templates.name: Session B
templates.summary: Full body: step-up, press, hip hinge, row and core.

templates.name: Session C
templates.summary: Full body: squat, split squat, push-up, row and planks.

templates.summary: Optional brisk walk on firm sand.

templates.summary: Optional jog and walk intervals on firm sand.
